description: Ask the human to do something in the browser, and show the request in the on-page badge with a confirmation button. Returns immediately — poll session_poll_user_action for the outcome. Also relay the instruction in your reply, so it is visible whether or not they are looking at the browser window.

instruction.description: Exactly what the person should do, in one sentence.

wait_for.description: What counts as done. 'confirmation' — the on-page button — is the only unambiguous one.
